overview: This Senate resolution honors Master Sergeant Nicole M. Amor of White Bear Lake, Minnesota, a U.S. Army Reserve soldier who served for nearly 20 years. According to the resolution, she was one of six service members killed on March 1, 2026, when a drone attacked Port Shuaiba, Kuwait, where her unit was deployed in support of Operation Epic Fury. It recognizes her service, awards and previous deployments, offers sympathy to her family and everyone affected by the attack, and asks that a copy be sent to her family. The Senate approved it on March 25, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is fitting for the Senate to formally honor a soldier who gave her life in service and to recognize her family's loss.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending, though resolutions like this are rarely opposed.
